changes_require: a new analysis-plan version and a fresh human review
compact20_role: pilot / feasibility / protocol validation only; no confirmatory claim may cite it
design: paired within-item, within-model clean vs intervention

exploratory_tests.model_by_family_interaction: within-design permutation of family labels across items; reported as exploratory because prospective power is below 0.80 across the whole SESOI grid
exploratory_tests.rank_instability: reported only as excess over the matched zero-degradation noise floor; the raw reversal probability is not an estimand

missing_data: trajectories that fail to complete are reported and excluded pairwise; the exclusion count is published

primary_test.multiplicity: single primary endpoint; no correction required
primary_test.name: one-sided paired test on per-item clean minus intervention success

secondary_tests.per_family_degradation: Holm correction across the four intervention families
